title: Exclusive non-embedded subwindows don't close on main window quit
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.6.2

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot 4.6.2 stable - Vulkan (Forward+)  - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop GPU

### Issue description

When closing the main window while it has an exclusive non-embedded window child, instead of normal quit behavior, the main window becomes borderless, and the subwindow is unaffected.

```
Additionally, the error "E 0:00:02:109   _load_from_cache: Condition "br != variant_size" is true. Returning: false
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shader_rd.cpp:481 @ _load_from_cache()" is given.
```

Possibly user error as I'm not sure how to exit the exclusive window appropriately. In any case, a workaround is to just not use exclusive and implement your own similar behavior. But I would like to know what's going on here.

### Steps to reproduce

1) Create a project and scene.
2) Add a window child with the properties "exclusive" and "transient" enabled.
3) Disable "embed subwindows" in the settings
4) Run the project
5) Exit the project using the close button on the main window
6) Observe that no windows have closed, instead the main window has becomes borderless

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[temp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27658526/temp.zip)
